title: Inventory preserved legacy CCP files and versions
description:
Scope: legacy CCP families and explicitly reused primitive fixtures under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/, together with their entries in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/README.md. Produce a bounded file/version inventory recording actual paths, byte digests, format_version, declared policy/wire versions, case IDs/counts, schema references and overlapping family names. Independently enumerate the relevant files and compare them with the existing catalog rather than trusting its old count. Preserve legacy files and catalog history; no fixture regeneration, deletion, renaming, deduplication or test change belongs in this inventory unit.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Extend the existing catalog or corpus metadata rather than creating a second inventory framework. This unit establishes preserved file/version facts only; provenance and semantic reuse decisions belong to the next unit.
acceptance_criteria: Every relevant existing CCP fixture and reused primitive has an inventory entry tied to actual bytes and separately identified format/policy/wire versions. Independent directory/file and case-ID checks expose missing catalog entries, duplicate/overlapping families, absent versions and schema gaps without silently normalizing them. Both legacy rendezvous filename variants remain preserved. Byte digests before and after the inventory work agree for legacy fixture data, and no production formula supplies inventory facts or expected outcomes.
